instructions_to_main_agent: IMPERATIVE: You are building a React.js application (NOT TypeScript/TSX). Use .js and .jsx extensions.
THEME: STRICTLY use the defined palette. No standard Tailwind blues (bg-blue-500). Use bg-[#E67E22] or semantic classes.
OUTSTANDING AMOUNT: Any display of outstanding/pending money MUST be in red text (#E74C3C).
LAYOUT: Implement a responsive sidebar. On mobile, use a Sheet/Drawer component triggered by a hamburger menu. On desktop, fixed sidebar.
CHARTS: Use Recharts. Custom Tooltip is mandatory. Style the tooltip to match the dark theme (bg-[#1A2B3C] border-[#2E4057]).
FORMS: Use Shadcn UI form components (Labels, Inputs, Selects). Customize them to remove white backgrounds and set bg-[#0D1B2A].
TESTING: Add `data-testid` to EVERY interactive element (buttons, inputs, links). Format: `role-action-target` (e.g., `admin-approve-resident-btn`).
EMPTY STATES: Do not leave tables empty. If no data, show a centered div with a Lucide icon (e.g., FileX) and a message 'No records found'.
ROUTING: Use react-router-dom v6+. Ensure protected routes check for roles.
universal_guidelines: Spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Don't cramp text.
Contrast: Ensure text on cards is #ECF0F1 (Primary) or #AEB6BF (Secondary). Never use dark gray on dark navy.
Border Radius: Use rounded-xl for all cards and modals. Use rounded-lg for buttons and inputs.
Motion: Add `transition-all duration-200` to buttons and interactive cards. No `transition: all` on layout containers.
Feedback: Use Sonner for toast notifications on success/error.
